parts.text: Edit this image: 1) Dress him in an all-black hooded cloak, the hood up over his head framing the diamond skull mask, heavy tattered black fabric covering his body and arms. 2) Remove the scythe from his back completely. 3) Replace the machete in his right fist with a gleaming polished chrome hunting knife dripping blood. 4) His other hand holds an old flip cell phone up near his chest, screen glowing. Keep the sparkling diamond skull mask, the blood moon haunted woods background, pose and the matte clay stop-motion style exactly the same.
